answer: Under this design, every account must lock 50 POA in a shared harbor contract before the epoch's words are published; a lantern beacon reveals the words only after the lock snapshot closes. Stake counts at each account's balance nadir across the window, so coins shuttled between sybils count once. 1,000 fakes need 50,000 POA idle every round, not just for the few later graded. Recycled locks are visible on-ledger and slashed in full. Colluders cannot share collateral, since each coin occupies one harbor slot. Honest users lock once and get it back.
